% Pattern: env/newtheorem/article. Numbers after \appendix.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem A.1 flag=appendix
% want theorem-3 statement/theorem B.1 flag=appendix
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{Body}
\begin{theorem}
In the body.
\end{theorem}
\appendix
\section{First appendix}
\begin{theorem}
In appendix A.
\end{theorem}
\section{Second appendix}
\begin{theorem}
In appendix B.
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
